comments: f4ea2574: ;Call the entry point DE and then continue execution at the label BEGIN.

c0fb931a: ;Set up parameters for calling FileMan. DIE is the global root, DIC is the
;file number, DP is the global root file number, DL is the LAYGO parameter,
;DIEL is the AUDITING parameter, and DU is the FDA array root. Check if
;there are any multiples for the current entry and quit if there aren't.

30d9f9c1: ;If there is a value in the .01 field of the 0 node, store it in the
;local variable DE(1).
e811c815: ;Kill the temporary variable %Z and quit.
287f833f: Write the Fileman prompt to the screen.
ca75a0a0: Exit the routine.
ab54cbda: Subroutine to write the prompt text, truncating if it exceeds 45 columns.

ad4a2bc2: If the prompt text is longer than 19 characters and it is not a free-text prompt or Help frame prompt, go to RW^DIR2 to display the prompt text and input data correctly. RW^DIR2 is a routine that handles the display and input of long prompts.
cf6a4b77: If the prompt text is not empty and it is not a free-text prompt and it is a MUMPS code entry, display '(No Editing)', indicating that the user cannot edit the MUMPS code.
a7c0343c: Read user input with a timeout value and store it in X. If the user times out, set DTOUT to the up-arrow character and X to the up-arrow character. Sound the terminal bell.
90f1769b: Exit the routine.
78d64664: Initialize the data quality subscript and increment the value.
ac479649: Branch to the executable code at the subscript location.
a5edde5c: If a computed expression is found, go to the RECOMPUTE section, otherwise do word-wrapping and tab resolution.

071d0735: If null data is entered and the field is not required and not XECUTABLE, go to the NXTER section. If it is required and XECUTABLE, go back to the INPUT reader. If the data is not valid, go back to the INPUT reader.
6febe754: If the entered data is a question mark, go to the HELP section. If it starts with an up-arrow, do DA array processing and chain to ^DIE17.
ecc1bc63: If the entered data is an @ sign, do DA array processing and chain to Z^DIE2.

7e2f18b0: If the entered data is a space, and this is a DATE/TIME multiple, and the user has a DEFAULT for this field, use the DEFAULT value. If the field is not WORD-PROCESSING, print the DEFAULT value.

dc574dfd: If the entered data matches an entry in the MULTIPLE, check the DIC("S") syntax for the MULTIPLE, and print the external form of the matched entry. If there are transforms, execute them and print the resulting external form. If the field is not WORD-PROCESSING, go back to the reader.

3bfc55d3: If the entered data does not match any entry in the MULTIPLE, loop through each entry checking for a partial match. If a partial match is found, check the DIC("S") syntax, and if passed, quit the loop.
968d7f9f: If the entered data is a partial match for an entry in the MULTIPLE and DIC("S") was passed, print the remaining unmatched characters and update X with the matched characters.
667996c0: If the DIC call is unsuccessful, i.e. X<0, then exit.
d5f5a2d3: If the input value does not have a numeric portion, go to the exit point.
c34db6df: If the field is a number, remove any leading or trailing zeroes.
e17533cf: Execute any special computed expression for this field.
7d63ff0c: Store the final value in the global variable DG, and if auditing is enabled, store it in the DIE audit trail.
61792b34: If database integration is turned on, go to code for database integration.
3509a93d: Set X to indicate a bad data value.
a78d66bc: Handle errors by displaying them and quitting.
ea6bd9b2: Store information about the current field being edited, including data from the DATA dictionary.

d267fc1b: If there is no input transform, go to the appropriate code block based on the value of X. If X is '@', read a new value. If X is not '@' and the field is not read-only, allow editing. If X is not '@' and the field is read-only, display the current value and quit.
78148c73: If there is an input transform defined, execute it on the user's input and go to the 'RP' label.
d0e71795: Updates DIC based on zero node or .01 field properties of referenced file.
55e04229: Updates DIC based on zero node properties for entries in file specified by Y.
f7eddded: Handles other DIC parameter codes: D for DIWP call, S to stuff Y into X.
3c3b79a2: ;If data is invalid, quit. If data valid and field multi-valued or word-processing, branch to field type-specific code.
dc27b1aa: ;If input transform doesn't contain 'I' or '#', go to reader loop.
18a3cd49: ;Execute input transform, go to reader loop if data present, else protocol.
16335eb9: ;Set default values for variables.
7235a8d2: ;Set field parameters for DATE DICTATED field.
f1dddace: ;Go to reader loop.
9b94ad4e: ;Store current date/time in internal format and remove if invalid.
991dd1bb: ;If data is defined, execute computed fields, store in 'Y', go to 'X2' if 'Y' defined. If 'Y' is updatable, set 'X', set flags, and go to output transform.
96dd6085: If the input value is empty, set the DGJTST variable to 'INCOMPLETE' and set Y to '@2'.
67e5a705: Exit the routine.

3837e998: If the DG array is defined, call the F^DIE17 routine followed by the DE routine. Set Y to the up-arrow character and DQ to 3. Call the X3 routine. If Y is undefined or equal to the up-arrow character, go to the A label. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to the value of DQ, and go to the OUT^DIE17 label.

8a298b09: Assign the DGJTDDT variable the value of either the .01 field of the entry in the DGPM file corresponding to the .04 field of the VAS(393) file entry (if it exists), or the .03 field of the VAS(393) file entry (if the .04 field is empty).
24c3ac31: Exit the routine.

ee294c78: If the DG array is defined, call the F^DIE17 routine followed by the DE routine. Set Y to the up-arrow character and DQ to 4. Call the X4 routine. If Y is undefined or equal to the up-arrow character, go to the A label. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to the value of DQ, and go to the OUT^DIE17 label.
7e79a05c: Do not allow date before event date. If date entered is before event date, blank out date value and warn user.
51fc0bcf: Exit this routine.
17834dd8: If variable DG is defined, call the routine DIE17 to update or re-edit fields, then go to ^DGJXA10.
